facts.note: Transcript gives the temple striking nine with the watch showing twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle making a scene about it in front of everyone.
Félix went up to the library and stayed there alone. He heard the temple strike ten and did not look at his watch.

At eighteen minutes past ten by his watch, a thump on the floor right above him in the atelier, then the uncle's repeater: ten slow deep notes he counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones he did not count.
At a quarter past ten by his watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door; at twenty-one minutes past ten someone came quickly down. He did not see who and the door was shut.
The aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.
Girard came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
